payload.title: Working with ensembles in `PyLiPD`
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to work with age ensembles using the `PyLiPD` library, which is designed for handling LiPD format data. The notebook focuses on reading and analyzing uncertainty ensembles, particularly age ensembles, from LiPD objects. It uses datasets from McCabe-Glynn et al. (2013) and Lawrence et al. (2006) to illustrate the process. The notebook includes methods for loading data, extracting ensemble tables, and working with specific datasets to analyze paleo data.
goals: Reading an ensemble from a LiPD object
Analyzing age uncertainty in paleo datasets

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the `PyLiPD` library and its capability to handle age ensembles stored in LiPD format. It demonstrates loading datasets and extracting ensemble tables using the `LiPD` class.
section_blurbs.heading: Working with ensembles in `PyLiPD`

section_blurbs.blurb: This part focuses on analyzing the Crystal Cave record by extracting ensemble tables and time series essentials for specific datasets. It highlights the use of dataset names to filter and analyze paleo data.
section_blurbs.heading: Working with the PaleoData

inputs: LiPD datasets from McCabe-Glynn et al. (2013)
LiPD datasets from Lawrence et al. (2006)
